goal: Verify that a user can create a new Site Host account and successfully navigate the calendar view from the initial month to a future month using the navigation controls.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the calendar for 'June 2026', click the 'Previous month' button (left arrow) to navigate to May 2026.
From the May 2026 view, click the 'Next month' button (right arrow) three consecutive times to advance the calendar to September 2026.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the sign-up page to the main dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The calendar view updates to display 'May 2026' immediately after clicking the previous month button.
The calendar view displays 'September 2026' after clicking the next month button three times.
The main content area displays existing memos or the 'No data found' state without errors during navigation.
